insertText.text: The 2026 upgrade of Crypto Focus Garden (BLAZE 2025: 3rd place, BitcoinCash Innovation Award).
A focus timer with stakes: while you focus, Bitcoin Cash time-locks a tree; stay, and the app delivers it to your wallet as a CashTokens NFT. Leave, and it withers.
[Contracts live on Mainnet · first app plant: Pending]
(any modern browser plus a BCH wallet; about 15,000 sats)
The website is the app's web build in a phone frame. The judge guide is at focus.salemkode.com/#blaze.

Amina sits down to study. Four minutes later she's scrolling, because quitting a timer costs nothing.
With Focus Garden she pledges a session. Stay, and her tree grows and comes to her wallet. Leave for 10 seconds, and it withers.
The problem is attention. Timers fail because breaking them is free and keeping them proves nothing anyone else can see.

updatePageElementAltText.title: Focus Garden walkthrough
updatePageElementAltText.description: 1 Connect: tested with a WizardConnect test wallet. 2 Fund the fee wallet: tested wallet creation and balance reads. 3 First mainnet plant: pending. 4 First mainnet release: pending.

insertText.text: 1 Connect: WizardConnect shares a receive key branch, and the app uses the first receive address; it never asks the wallet to sign. 2 Fund the fee wallet with one coin of ≥8,000 sats (≈15,000 covers a plant and a release). 3 Plant with Verify on: the app builds the FocusForest plantTree transaction, checks it in the BCH 2026 VM, signs and broadcasts. 4 Stay. When the lock matures, the app sends the tree to the linked wallet. A withered session doesn't get the automatic delivery.

A reason to stay. Leave for 10 seconds and your tree withers. [Tested locally]
A reward you own. Kept sessions become CashTokens NFTs in your own wallet, with pictures from our BCMR registry. [Contracts and metadata: Done on Mainnet · first delivery: Pending]
No account, no server we run. The app talks to Bitcoin Cash through public Electrum servers. [Done on Mainnet (read-only)]
app blocking (Screen Time / usage access) in the native apps, not re-verified for this entry; profile cards, a leaderboard of pledged focus, and tips.

Plant
mint tree NFT,
2,000-sat fee + 1,000-sat deposit

Time lock
BIP68, 512-second steps,
matures by median block time

Release
NFT and deposit to your wallet,
2,000-sat fee
Merge · matured trees combine inside the contract.

FocusForest + FocusDirectory (CashScript, P2SH32), live on mainnet since 19 Nov 2026 (block 977999). [Done on Mainnet]
WizardConnect wallet linking (WalletConnect too). [Tested (test wallet)]
Every transaction is built, VM-checked and signed in the app; contract + protocol tests. [Tested locally]

Why BCH: native tokens without a token contract, covenant time locks that every node enforces, and fees of a few thousand sats. The XO engine (@xo-cash/engine, stock p2pkh template) runs the native fee wallet only; the web uses a single-key wallet.
App reads gardens, balances and leaderboard from mainnet
Tested with a dedicated test wallet, 20 Nov

Limits: the chain checks time, not attention; the app checks that you stay. The leaderboard counts pledged time. Delivery waits for the lock to mature (up to about an hour after the session) and for the app to be open. On the web, the fee wallet's key lives in the browser.
test counts and per-claim details are in the appendix and SUBMISSION.md.

First buyer: study groups. A shared garden for a class or study circle, paid per group in BCH or pUSD. [Planned]
Promises with stakes. Put pUSD behind a pledge: keep it and it comes back; break it and it goes to a cause you chose. [Planned]
Success measure: groups that come back for a second week.
Mainnet: contract deployment and reads; first web plant pending
public Electrum → packages/protocol builder → app policy check, signing and BCH VM check → broadcast.
Signers: XO-engine wallet on iPhone and Android, single-key wallet in the browser.
05 | owner pkh (where the tree goes) | planter tag (who planted) | stamp | units (lock length) | look (tier × 16 + species)
On-chain tiers: Sprout (≥1 unit, 8.5 min) · Tree (≥3) · Big tree (≥6) · House (≥11); 3 sprouts → tree, 2 trees → big tree, 2 big trees → house.

Nov 2025 (BLAZE 2025): Crypto Focus Garden: Next.js web dApp, one Chipnet contract with a relaxed time check. Public.
9–13 Nov 2026 (before kickoff): a private Expo prototype reusing the 2025 contract on Chipnet (9–10 Nov); the React Native Libauth adapter started (13 Nov, public repo).
14–22 Nov 2026 (BLAZE): the FocusForest and FocusDirectory contracts and their mainnet deployment with BCMR; the Expo app for iPhone, Android and the web; on-device transaction building; WizardConnect and WalletConnect linking; leaderboard, profiles and tips; the web fee wallet and the banner.
